const (
	Idle      Status = "idle"
	Running   Status = "running"
	Stopping  Status = "stopping"
	Completed Status = "completed"
	Cancelled Status = "cancelled"
	Failed    Status = "failed"
)

const MaxDraftBytes = 32 * 1024

func (m *Model) Admitted(runID, prompt string)

func (m *Model) AttachRun(runID string, status Status)

func (m *Model) CanSend() bool

func (m *Model) FailAdmission(err error)

func (m *Model) LastSequence() uint64

func (m *Model) Observe(runID string, seq uint64, text string, status Status, failure string) bool

func (m *Model) Prompt() (string, error)

func (m *Model) RequestStop() string

func (m *Model) StatusText() string

func (v *NativeView) AtEnd() bool

func (v *NativeView) Build(c *ui.Context)

func (v *NativeView) BuildChat(c *ui.Context)

func (v *NativeView) BuildMessages(c *ui.Context)

func (v *NativeView) ScrollToEnd()

func (v *NativeView) SetMarkdownOptions(options *markdown.Options)

func InspectionGroup(entry storage.RecordEntry) string

func InspectionGroupVisible(entry storage.RecordEntry, group string) bool

func NewModel(demo bool) *Model

func NewModelWithRetention(demo bool, rows int) *Model

func NewNativeView(model *Model) *NativeView

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/egoist/mygo/ui"
	"github.com/egoist/mygo/ui/markdown"
)

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/platform/storage"
	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/sdk/kernel/abi"
)

type Message struct {
	ID     string
	RunID  string
	Role   string
	Text   string
	Status Status
	Error  string
}

type Model struct {
	Draft       string
	Messages    []Message
	ActiveRunID string
	Status      Status
	Error       string
	Notice      string
	Demo        bool
	RouteLabel  string
}

type NativeView struct {
	Model          *Model
	Send           func()
	Stop           func()
	Busy           bool
	LargePasteHint string
}

type Status string
